from collections import Counter
from io import BytesIO
import json,runpy
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
from pypdf import PdfReader
import aspose.words_foss as aw
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__
root=Path('/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python')
font=runpy.run_path(str(root/'tests/test_pdf_shaping.py'))['arabic_font']()
records={}
for table in (False,True):
 for sup in (False,True):
  runs=[ldm.Run(text='Q ',font=ldm.Font(size=20)),ldm.Run(text='سلام ',font=ldm.Font(size=20,superscript=sup,subscript=not sup)),ldm.Run(text='T',font=ldm.Font(size=20))]
  p=ldm.Paragraph(children=runs)
  item=ldm.Table(rows=[ldm.Row(cells=[ldm.Cell(children=[p])])]) if table else p
  model=ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(body=ldm.Body(children=[item]))])
  options=aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions();options.text_shaping=True;options.fallback_fonts=[str(font)]
  raw=LdmPdfWriter(options).write_to_bytes(model)
  with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
   spans=[s for b in pdf[0].get_text('dict')['blocks'] for line in b.get('lines',[]) for s in line['spans']]
   arabic=[s for s in spans if any(c in s['text'] for c in 'سلام')]
   baseline=next(s['origin'][1] for s in spans if 'Q' in s['text'])
   assert arabic and all(abs(s['size']-14)<0.05 for s in arabic)
   assert all(abs(s['origin'][1]-(baseline-8 if sup else baseline+3))<0.05 for s in arabic)
   assert all(abs(s['size']-20)<0.05 for s in spans if 'T' in s['text'])
   for text in (pdf[0].get_text(),PdfReader(BytesIO(raw)).pages[0].extract_text()):
    assert Counter(c for c in text if c in 'سلام')==Counter('سلام')
   records[f'{table}-{sup}']={'bytes':len(raw),'pages':len(pdf),'arabic_spans':arabic,'normal_baseline_pt':baseline,'pymupdf_and_pypdf_character_counts_preserved':True}
Path('/tmp/docweave-vertical-fallback.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Four installed mixed-font RTL script cases verified',font)
